recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, warm-toned portrait of a man in a cowboy hat leaning out of a vintage vehicle window, framed by a heavy red-to-orange gradient overlay on the right side containing weathered, stacked typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the window geometry
Color transition from natural sepia to saturated red overlay
Textured typography mirroring the rugged aesthetic of the subject
Thin rounded border framing the entire composition
coreInvariants: Warm sepia and red color palette
Soft-focus background with sharp foreground subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, medium close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and cowboy hat serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the subject's gaze on the left, across the window frame to the bold vertical text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right third is filled with a semi-transparent color wash and text, acting as functional negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and tan tones in the photography.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red and burnt orange gradient overlay on the right.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Black for primary text; off-white for secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red overlay contrasting with the desaturated, earthy tones of the photo.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and fiery reds

letterConstructionRules: Eroded edges and internal grit texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature irregular 'ink-bleed' or 'weathered wood' distressing

composition.relationshipToImage: anchored in the red gradient zone

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact distressed display face paired with a clean, wide-tracked italic sans-serif for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Authentic distressed letterpress look with condensed proportions.
Strong vertical presence suitable for country music aesthetics.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a man in a cowboy hat leaning out of a vintage camper window, sepia-toned with a heavy red-to-transparent gradient on the right side. Apply a thin white rounded-rectangle border and overall film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add stacked, condensed, distressed black sans-serif text in the upper right red zone. Below it, add a smaller line of wide-tracked, off-white italic sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the red gradient sufficiently saturated?
Does the text have a weathered, stamped texture?
Is the thin rounded border present?
Is the subject's face clear despite the warm tones?

adjustableVariables: Level of distressing on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Typography must look integrated into the texture of the image.
The red overlay must not completely obscure the background details.
The overall mood must feel rugged and nostalgic.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a sepia-toned rustic portrait with a saturated color-block overlay and distressed condensed typography to create a modern-vintage country aesthetic.
